changeSet.author: credesal
changeSet.comment: Replace the Arissto-only cash and bank source-fact projection with Fineract journal cash postings.
changeSet.sql:
UPDATE stretchy_report SET report_sql = $report$ WITH RECURSIVE selected_offices AS ( SELECT office_under.id FROM m_office selected_office JOIN m_office office_under ON office_under.hierarchy LIKE selected_office.hierarchy || '%' WHERE selected_office.id = CAST('${officeId}' AS BIGINT) AND office_under.hierarchy LIKE '${currentUserHierarchy}' || '%' ), cash_roots AS ( SELECT account.id FROM acc_gl_account account WHERE account.gl_code IN ('111001', '111004')
UNION
SELECT configured.gl_account_id FROM credesal_cash_flow_cash_account configured WHERE configured.active ), cash_tree AS ( SELECT root.id AS account_id, ARRAY[root.id]::BIGINT[] AS account_path FROM cash_roots root
UNION ALL
SELECT child.id, tree.account_path || child.id FROM cash_tree tree JOIN acc_gl_account child ON child.parent_id = tree.account_id WHERE NOT child.id = ANY(tree.account_path) ), cash_accounts AS ( SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM cash_tree ), account_ancestry AS ( SELECT account.id AS descendant_account_id, account.id AS ancestor_account_id, ARRAY[account.id]::BIGINT[] AS account_path FROM acc_gl_account account
UNION ALL
SELECT ancestry.descendant_account_id, parent.id, ancestry.account_path || parent.id FROM account_ancestry ancestry JOIN acc_gl_account child ON child.id = ancestry.ancestor_account_id JOIN acc_gl_account parent ON parent.id = child.parent_id WHERE NOT parent.id = ANY(ancestry.account_path) ), cash_postings AS ( SELECT journal.id, journal.transaction_id, journal.ref_num, journal.office_id, journal.account_id, journal.entry_date, COALESCE(journal.transaction_date, journal.entry_date) AS operation_date, journal.type_enum, journal.amount, journal.description, journal.header_concept, journal.header_description, journal.check_number FROM acc_gl_journal_entry journal JOIN cash_accounts cash ON cash.account_id = journal.account_id WHERE journal.office_id IN (SELECT id FROM selected_offices) AND journal.currency_code = 'USD' AND journal.type_enum IN (1, 2) AND COALESCE(journal.transaction_date, journal.entry_date) BETWEEN CAST('${startDate}' AS DATE) AND CAST('${endDate}' AS DATE) ) SELECT CASE WHEN posting.type_enum = 2 THEN 'ingreso' ELSE 'egreso' END AS "Tipo movimiento", COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(posting.header_concept), ''), NULLIF(BTRIM(posting.description), ''), account.name) AS "Concepto", ROUND(posting.amount, 2) AS "Monto", CONCAT_WS(' · ', account.name, NULLIF(BTRIM(posting.header_description), ''), NULLIF(BTRIM(posting.check_number), '')) AS "Observaciones", COALESCE(classification.line_label, 'SIN CLASIFICAR') AS "Flujo efectivo", COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(posting.ref_num), ''), NULLIF(BTRIM(posting.transaction_id), ''), 'GL-' || posting.id::text) AS "Transacción", posting.operation_date AS "Fecha operación" FROM cash_postings posting JOIN acc_gl_account account ON account.id = posting.account_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT mapping.line_label) = 1 THEN MIN(mapping.line_label) END AS line_label FROM acc_gl_journal_entry counterpart JOIN account_ancestry ancestry ON ancestry.descendant_account_id = counterpart.account_id JOIN credesal_cash_flow_mapping mapping ON mapping.gl_account_id = ancestry.ancestor_account_id AND mapping.active AND mapping.cash_direction = CASE WHEN posting.type_enum = 2 THEN 'I' ELSE 'O' END WHERE counterpart.transaction_id = posting.transaction_id AND counterpart.office_id = posting.office_id AND counterpart.entry_date = posting.entry_date AND counterpart.account_id NOT IN (SELECT account_id FROM cash_accounts) ) classification ON TRUE ORDER BY posting.operation_date, posting.office_id, COALESCE(posting.ref_num, posting.transaction_id, posting.id::text), posting.id $report$, description = 'Listado de movimientos de caja y banco registrados en el diario de Fineract.' WHERE report_name = 'Transacciones de Flujo de Efectivo' AND report_category = 'Accounting';
